planned_arguments.prompt:
Edit the referenced own poster into one finished flat opaque portrait poster, width:height 2:3. Keep its three staggered broad horizontal story frames and ALL nine existing printed Korean entries, digits, punctuation, word spaces, placement, readable scale and natural line wraps unchanged. Keep the title/event/schedule adjacent to the opening frame, bring/activity adjacent to sewing, and free/invitation adjacent to the final exchange. No additional text, numbering, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, captions, mockup or comparison sheet. The text was observed as readable, so protect it carefully.

Observed repair cause and concrete correction: the opening terracotta shirt already has a long stitch-like diagonal line, and the next frame's stitches cross the shirt front; this makes the specific unrepaired-to-repaired change unclear. Redraw only this clothing action so both frames plainly depict the SAME terracotta button-front shirt with the SAME chest pocket and shape. First frame: two calm adults examine a small visibly OPEN section of the LOWER HEM, with that hem flap lifted and a loose dangling thread, but NO completed stitches across the opening and NO diagonal tear across the whole front. Second frame: the same lower-hem section is now laid flat, its fabric edges JOINED by a short tidy row of stitches; one naturally drawn hand holds the fine sewing needle/thread as it finishes the seam while the other hand steadies the fabric. Keep scissors and spool in useful positions. Make the state change visibly readable inside the frames rather than relying on words.

Related visual simplification: remove the little ochre botanical sprig beside the title and the green/ochre flower sprig below the invitation. Leave clean cream space there. Within all three frames simplify the dense plants/shelves/bulletin marks, fabric texture and woodgrain into a calm editorial ink drawing with solid OPAQUE warm color fields and consistent dark brown contour lines. Preserve the real actions, human/table context and friendly modest expressions. Use minimal plain background planes so the hands, shirt states and pitcher transfer carry the story. Avoid shaded anime rendering, glossy highlights, gradients, fake background writing, texture haze and unrelated ornament.

Protected advantages: keep the recognizable first/second shirt continuity, three broad framed actions, alternating text-image rhythm, generous schedule/participation text contrast, and the final two-neighbor green-handled-pitcher handover with plausible shared hand support; keep the folded terracotta shirt quietly visible in the last frame. Retain the existing warm cream, terracotta, muted green and small ochre palette, opaque background and controlled consistent ink finish. Exactly one complete finished poster. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력
